preflight.action_frame: normalized world velocity xyz ×[1.5,1.5,1.0]m/s and world yaw-rate ×1rad/s; NOT body velocity or motor commands
preflight.expert: translation clip(error/3) independent of yaw; yaw_rate clip(yaw_error), same observation/no privileged input
preflight.coupling: world velocity PI creates desired world acceleration/thrust; yaw-dependent desired attitude and rotor allocation change real transient dynamics
preflight.information_gap: no missing inputs relative to expert; 7D is not full physical/controller Markov state
